title: Personal Training Packages: auto-renewal availability and discount, and the unlimited-tier weekly fair-use cap, by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether the package may auto-renew once exhausted, the discount rate applied to an auto-renewed package, and, for the unlimited tier only, the per-week cap on sessions counted toward fair use.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Auto-renewal available | Auto-renewal discount (percent) | Weekly fair-use cap (sessions per week, unlimited tier only) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | No | 0 | 0 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | No | 0 | 0 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | No | 0 | 0 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Yes | 5 | 0 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | Yes | 0 | 5 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | No | 0 | 0 |

## Points of reference
Only 20-Session Performance Pack and Unlimited Monthly Coaching may auto-renew once exhausted; the other four tiers of Personal Training Packages may not. Of the two that may auto-renew, only 20-Session Performance Pack lists a nonzero auto-renewal discount, at 5 percent; Unlimited Monthly Coaching's auto-renewal carries no discount. The weekly fair-use cap applies only to Unlimited Monthly Coaching, since it is the only tier that grants unlimited use rather than a fixed session count; every other tier lists 0 for this cap because it is not the unlimited tier.
